svg.title: Paired persistence, rollback and restart recovery
svg.desc: A logical vault update is not a single filesystem-atomic swap. Storage stages and rereads config and vault, invokes caller verification, snapshots the previous complete pair, journals the target pair, then replaces the two files. Exceptions attempt rollback; the journal is removed only after both restorations succeed. A restart with a valid pending journal writes its target pair before deleting the journal. Invalid journals fail without replacement.

g.text: Paired persistence, rollback and restart recovery
Read arrows in order. SECRET = plaintext; KEY = encryption key; cylinders = stored data.

g.data-label: Input: serialized config and encrypted vault payload
Read previous files Write two temporary files
Reread bounded staging files Parse config and payload envelope
Run caller verification Crypto checks for setup/reset/restore Session checks for ordinary save
Recheck authorization if supplied Snapshot previous complete pair
Recheck authorization again Write .state-transaction with target pair
Delete journal and prune to 5 snapshots Clean temporary files
